note: Measured from the IMC past job, not a rule of the client, written by python/floor_fit.py --write and never by hand (R135, R136). outlines: per floor kind one group per unit, mirror flag and plot width, the width being the front edge of the baseplan face (R122) rounded to cadLinks.floorWidthStepM. loops are in the axes of the link, x along its X axis and y along its Y axis from its origin, so the outline is placed by the insert, rotation and mirror flag of the link. type is the floor type most of the group carry. The loops are the outline of the plot of the fit half nearest all the others (the medoid), fitError and testError count the plots of each half by the Hausdorff distance of the boundaries, a group with tooFew true was fitted on all its plots and not tested. rampTypes: the slope of each past ramp along its depth, back corners over front corners, per type, and the bands that pick a type, cut halfway between the medians. A type whose median lies in the band of another is listed in notSeparable. rampFront: the median of the front corner level minus the road level at the curb point nearest the corner (R91, R94). Lengths are in metres, slopes in percent.
